title: Identifiability of a linear dynamical reaction-diffusion system with directed interactions from the second-order statistics of a single snapshot
summary: A single spatial snapshot of a system with multiple interacting populations captures positions but not the underlying dynamics that have led to the observation. This work asks what the stationary second-order spatial statistics of a snapshot can reveal about the structure of the linear reaction-diffusion dynamical model, and in particular about the pairwise directed entries of its interaction operator.
